cardEffects: [Main] 1 of your non-white Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Sukamon] in its name in your hand without paying the cost, ignoring its digivolution requirements.
name: Suka's Curse

references.text: Official JP Q&A for BT14-097 (2023/06/23, translated by DeepL)
Official JP Q&A for BT14-097 (2024/09/20, translated by DeepL)

rulings.question: Can this card's effect digivolve any level Digimon into a Digimon card with [Sukamon] in my hand as long as it is a non-white Digimon?

rulings.answer: No, it can't. This effect doesn't target Digimon in breeding areas.
rulings.question: Can this card's effect digivolve a Digimon in the breeding area into a Digimon card with [Sukamon] in my hand?

rulings.answer: This is a special rule for this card that treats it as a card that has [Sukamon]. This is a rule and not an effect, therefore this card is treated as having [Sukamon] when the card is in your hand, trash, or any other area.
rulings.question: What does this card's "(Rule) Name: Also treated as having [Sukamon]" mean, exactly?

rulings.answer: No, it can't. This card's name is treated as having [Sukamon], but it is not treated as [Sukamon].
rulings.question: Can this card be selected as the target of an effect that targets exactly [Sukamon] due to the text "(Rule) Name: Also treated as having [Sukamon]"?

rulings.answer: No, it can't. This card is an Option card, therefore it can't become a target for an effect that targets Digimon.
rulings.question: Can this card become a target for effects that activate for Digimon with [Sukamon]?

rulings.answer: It changes into a white card with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon]. In addition, it is also treated as the Digimon whose name is specified in (or specified to be included in) "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [XX]" or "(Rule) Name: Treated as having [XX]."
rulings.question: What happens when this card's [Security] effect activates for a Digimon with "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [XX]" or "(Rule) Name: Treated as having [XX]"?

rulings.answer: It remains as a white Digimon with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon]. The gained effect is carried over even if the Digimon digivolves or one or more of its top cards are trashed.
rulings.question: If a card has changed to a white Digimon with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon], then it digivolves or its top card is trashed by a ＜De-Digivolve＞ effect, what happens to that card's information?
Can the effect of this card evolve from any Digimon of any Lv. to a Digimon card with "Sukamon" in its name in my hand, as long as it is not white?

rulings.answer: No, you cannot. Digimon in the Breeding Area are not targeted for the effect.
rulings.question: Can the effect of this card evolve from a Digimon in the Breeding Area to a Digimon card with "Sukamon" in its name in my hand?

rulings.answer: This is a special rule for this card that also treats this card as containing "Sukamon" in its name. Since it is a rule, not an effect, this card will also be treated as containing "Sukamon" in its name, whether in hand, trash, or elsewhere.
rulings.question: This card's <Overflow X> name: "Also treats as containing 'Sukamon'." What does this mean?

rulings.answer: No, it cannot. This card is also treated as containing "Sukamon" in its name, but is not considered a "Sukamon".
rulings.question: <Overflow X> name: "Also treated as containing 'Sukamon'." can I select "Sukamon" as the target of an effect that targets only "Sukamon"?

rulings.answer: No, it does not. This card is an option card, so it cannot be targeted by effects that target Digimon.
rulings.question: Is this card targeted for the effect it activates on Digimon with "Sukamon" in its name?

rulings.answer: This effect changes the original name of one opponent's Digimon to "Sukamon", its original color to white, and its original DP to 3000.
rulings.question: "Change an opponent's Digimon to its original name "Sukamon", White, DP 3000." What is the effect?

rulings.answer: The information of the card you have is also changed by <Rules>. For example, the original name of "BT15-035 Gelemon" is "Gelemon/Numemon" by <Overflow X>, but if the information of the original card is changed by this effect, the original name will be "Sukamon" only.
rulings.question: What happens if a card such as "BT15-035 Geremon", which has card information in <Overflow X>, is changed to the original name "Sukamon", white, DP3000 by the effect of this card?

rulings.answer: The information on the card obtained by the effect remains the same. For example, if the information on the original card EX1-005 Tyrannomon is changed, the original color will be white and the color will be white and green because the effect of EX1-005 Tyrannomon also treats it as green.
rulings.question: What happens to a card such as "EX1-005 Tyrannomon" that has been given card information by the effect of this card, but is changed to the original name "Sukamon", white, DP3000 by the effect of this card?

rulings.answer: The card also retains its original name "Sukamon", white, DP 3000. The effect given is carried over even if that one digivolved or the stacked cards are trashed.
rulings.question: If a card whose original name is changed to "Sukamon", white, DP3000 is digivolved or stacked cards are trashed by <De-Digivolve>, what happens to the card's information?

rulings.answer: The original name "Sukamon" - White - remains changed to DP3000, but the information on the card that it originally did not have cannot be changed. If the card becomes a tamer or a Digitama card and does not originally have DP, it will remain without DP.
rulings.question: What happens if a card with the original name "Sukamon", white, DP3000 is stacked cards are trashed by <De-Digivolve>, etc. and become tamers or Digitama cards?

securityEffect: [Security] Until the end of your turn, change 1 of your opponent's Digimon into being white and having 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon]
